changes.text: Each sensor card shows when it last reported, and flags sensors that have gone quiet as "Stale".
Sensor pages now have a history graph and a list of recent readings with the time between each one.
A "Sensor parameters" section on each sensor page, showing how often it should report and how long its history is kept (editable by admins).
You now need to log in to see your sensors, and you only see the sensors linked to your account.
Dark mode, switchable from the menu or Settings.
inHabit can be installed as an app on Windows and Android.
Sensor cards show the right reading for each sensor type.
Refreshed menu, header and forms with clearer error messages.
Moving between sensor pages now loads the new sensor correctly.
